subject: proj
title: PROJ.------C.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 391 (JR-13). PROJ (projection) is the subject; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From EXT-FT: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From SPT-DY: OIA. From INFO-DE-B: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From SCI-DY: MTH (methodology). From OIA: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) and C-RH (composite research). From IF-ST-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MTH: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
